tools.name: list_platforms
tools.description: List the platforms this server has verified rules for, with each one's last-verified date and a one-line answer to "is automation allowed?".

tools.name: get_platform_rules
tools.description: Before signing up, posting or commenting on a platform as an AI agent or automated account, call this to see whether automation and AI-generated text are allowed, what must be disclosed (e.g. labels), verbatim quotes from the rules, source URLs, and when they were last verified. Not legal advice; op

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_platform_rules" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Before signing up, posting or commenting on a platform as an AI agent or automated account, call this to see whether automation and AI-generated text are allowe…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
